title: 第345章 四方无门阵
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这家伙怕不是脑子有问题，竟在这时候跳出来逞英雄，难道不知道赵家正处在怒头上吗。”

“年轻气盛呗，以为有点修为就要上天了，殊不知修行一道隐忍才是最重要的。”

“……看他怎么死。”

“……”

见韩林与赵家对峙，无论是各大家族强者还是筑基散修，全都一副鄙夷的样子。

唯独柳三春，眉头紧皱着，暗暗为韩林捏了一把汗。

他偷偷传音道：“韩兄你别闹了，赶紧下来，不然一会儿真收不了场了。”

可韩林却充耳不闻。

见赵家众人向自己释放威压，他非但不惧，反而冷笑一声：“你们算什么东西，也配检查本座的储物袋！”

说着气势一震，猛地释放出一股筑基后期的境界威压，朝着众人反压过去。

虽然境界威压对于同一个大境界来说，并不致命，但以他后期的修为，还是让其中四五名筑基初期的赵家修士，同时脸色脸色一白，露出震惊的表情。

而那些散修强者，也感受到这股威压，纷纷脸色一变，忽然觉得有点小瞧了这个年轻人。

“筑基后期！我说你哪来的勇气敢与我赵家为敌！不过你要认为筑基后期就能在我等面前放肆，那你就大错特错了！”

赵秉谦微微一惊后，大喝道：“此人多半就是谋害三长老的凶手，随我拿下！”

话音未落，他已率先出手，幻化出一座巨大的石山，对着韩林头顶狠狠压下。

其他众人则纷纷一掐法诀，朝韩林围攻而来。

“快走！”

山顶上其他筑基强者见状，脸色一变，跑得比兔子还快，转瞬间就消失在原地。

一些家族强者，则在飞遁的同时，大袖一挥，将自家的后辈一起卷出了山外。

轰——！

众人才刚刚飞起，身后就传来一阵惊天动地的轰鸣，密密麻麻的碎石尘土狂风暴雨般向山外飞去。

赵家十一名筑基强者联手一击，直接将聚元山的山顶都给掀翻，惹得各大家族强者又惊又怒。

若非他们反应快，及时带走自家晚辈，这一击绝对会让那些练气小辈全部殒命于此。

“啊——！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"I'm afraid there is something wrong with this guy's brain. He jumped out to act like a hero at this time. Doesn't he know that the Zhao family is in a state of anger?"

"You are young and energetic, and you think that if you have some cultivation, you will reach heaven. Little do you know that practicing forbearance is the most important thing."

"... Let's see how he dies."

"..."

Seeing the confrontation between Han Lin and the Zhao family, both the powerful members of the major families and the casual cultivators of the Foundation Establishment looked contemptuous.

Only Liu Sanchun frowned, secretly sweating for Han Lin.

He secretly sent a message: "Brother Han, please stop making trouble and come down quickly, otherwise it won't be over for a while."

But Han Lin turned a deaf ear.

Seeing everyone in the Zhao family unleashing their pressure on him, he was not afraid, but instead sneered: "Who do you think you are? You deserve to check my storage bag!"

As he spoke, his momentum trembled, and he suddenly released a pressure from the late stage of foundation building, pressing back against everyone.

Although the pressure of the realm is not fatal to the same large realm, with his later cultivation level, four or five of the Zhao family monks who were in the early stage of foundation building turned pale at the same time, showing expressions of shock.

The strong casual cultivators also felt this pressure, their expressions changed, and they suddenly felt that they had underestimated this young man.

"Late stage of foundation establishment! I asked you where did you get the courage to be the enemy of my Zhao family! But if you think that in the late stage of foundation establishment you can act arrogantly in front of us, then you are totally wrong!"

After Zhao Bingqian was slightly startled, he shouted: "This person is probably the murderer who murdered the third elder, let me take him down!"

Before he finished speaking, he took the lead and transformed into a huge stone mountain, pressing down hard on Han Lin's head.

Everyone else drew magic tricks one after another and came to besiege Han Lin.

"Let's go!"

When the other strong foundation builders on the top of the mountain saw this, their expressions changed, they ran faster than rabbits, and disappeared in the blink of an eye.

Some powerful family members, while flying away, waved their sleeves and swept their juniors out of the mountain together.

boom--!

Just as everyone took off, there was an earth-shattering roar behind them, and dense gravel and dust flew out of the mountain like a violent storm.

The eleven foundation-building masters of the Zhao family joined forces and knocked down the top of Juyuan Mountain with one attack, making the masters of the major families shocked and angry.

If they hadn't reacted quickly and taken away their juniors in time, this blow would have definitely killed all the junior Qi practitioners.

"Ah——!"
